claims.claim_text: The sustainability-related financial disclosures are intended to provide information about sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect cash flows, access to finance or cost of capital over the short, medium or long term (i.e., affect prospects).
entities: users of general purpose financial reports
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1.3 requirement text and is explicitly cited in the section.

claims.claim_text: To identify sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect prospects, IFRS S1 paragraphs B1–B12 are applied.
claims.support_notes: Directly aligns with IFRS S1.12 requirement to apply B1–B12.

claims.claim_text: Additional information is provided when compliance with specifically applicable IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards is insufficient for users to understand effects on cash flows, access to finance and cost of capital over the short, medium and long term.
entities: users of general purpose financial reports
claims.support_notes: Consistent with IFRS S1.15(b) fair presentation requirement.

claims.claim_text: Material information about sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect prospects is disclosed.
claims.support_notes: Restates IFRS S1.17 and is explicitly cited.

claims.claim_text: In identifying and disclosing material information, IFRS S1 paragraphs B13–B37 are applied.
claims.support_notes: Directly aligns with IFRS S1.19 requirement to apply B13–B37.

claims.claim_text: Sustainability-related financial disclosures are prepared for the same reporting entity as the related financial statements.

Information is presented to enable users to understand connections within the sustainability-related financial disclosures, including between governance, strategy, risk management, and metrics and targets.
entities: users of general purpose financial reports
claims.support_notes: Aligned to IFRS S1.21(b)(i) connectivity requirement.

claims.claim_text: Information is presented to enable users to understand connections across the sustainability-related financial disclosures and other general purpose financial reports published, including the related financial statements.
entities: users of general purpose financial reports
claims.support_notes: Aligned to IFRS S1.21(b)(ii) connectivity requirement.

claims.claim_text: The financial statements to which the sustainability-related financial disclosures relate are identified.

To the extent possible, data and assumptions used in sustainability-related financial disclosures are consistent with those used in preparing the related financial statements, considering IFRS Accounting Standards or other applicable GAAP.
When currency is specified as a unit of measure in the sustainability-related financial disclosures, the presentation currency of the related financial statements is used.

Disclosures are provided across IFRS S1 core content areas: governance, strategy, risk management, and metrics and targets, unless another IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard permits or requires otherwise.
claims.support_notes: Section explicitly lists the four core content areas and cites IFRS S1.25.

claims.claim_text: In identifying sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect prospects, IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards are applied.
The disclosure topics in the SASB Standards are referred to and their applicability is considered.
When a specific IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard applies to a sustainability-related risk or opportunity, that Standard’s disclosure requirements are applied.

When no IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard specifically applies, judgement is used to identify information that is relevant to users’ decision-making and faithfully represents the risk or opportunity.
entities: users of general purpose financial reports
evidence_sources: draft_markdown:1.7 Sources of guidance (IFRS S1.57(a), IFRS S1.57(b))
claims.support_notes: Combines both IFRS S1.57(a) and 57(b) requirements as stated in the section.

claims.claim_text: In making the judgement when no specific IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard applies, the applicability of SASB metrics associated with SASB disclosure topics is referred to and considered.

The specific standards, pronouncements, industry practice and other sources of guidance applied in preparing the sustainability-related financial disclosures are identified (including, if applicable, SASB disclosure topics).

The industry(s) specified in IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards, the SASB Standards or other sources of guidance applied in preparing the sustainability-related financial disclosures are identified, including in identifying applicable metrics.

Information required by an IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard may be included by cross-reference to another published report, and when cross-references are used IFRS S1 paragraphs B45–B47 are applied.
Sustainability-related financial disclosures are reported at the same time as the related financial statements and cover the same reporting period.
